name: flight-trajectory-visualizer
description: ✈️ 飞行足迹 · 3D 地球飞行可视化 | Personal flight logbook on an interactive WebGL globe. 导入航班 CSV，点亮你的飞行足迹；Privacy-first, 100% local, no server.

paragraphs: A privacy-first flight tracker. Import your flight CSV → get a cinematic 3D globe logbook. There is no server and no account: the app runs entirely in your browser and nothing is ever uploaded. The only way your data leaves the machine is the share link you generate and hand out yourself. Try it live →

▶ Demo video (36 s): Play it in your browser → — MP4 (2.9 MB) + WebM (3.9 MB), 1280×760; clicking the cover image opens it too. It shows importing a log, the aircraft riding its altitude profile, trip replay and the ranked airport search. The files themselves are demo.mp4 and demo.webm; the link above opens a page with a real player.

Flight Footprints turns your personal flight history into a beautiful, interactive 3D globe. Import a simple CSV of your flights (flight number, origin, destination, time) and instantly get a cinematic flight logbook: a chronological flight list, live statistics, airline recognition, route highlighting, an animated aircraft that flies along your selected route — and a full trip replay, all rendered on a WebGL Earth.
